objective: Obtain valid, development-only H1B implementation evidence sufficient to evaluate H1B_DEVELOPMENT_GATE without creating confirmatory H1B artifacts.
established_findings: development_attempt_v9 is debug-only and invalid for the H1B development gate; its results must not support authorization.
The executor, approximate continuation values, and exact evaluator were repaired to charge post-planning elapsed time to net D1; local H1B/R2 tests passed 68/68 after the repair.
The post-planning visible policy state now carries SCAN=703 and CONFIRM=138 minimum remaining ticks.
The existing verifier is circular because it imports and re-runs production execution and evaluator code.
active_hypotheses: A frozen, result-blind clarification can define a unique generative transition kernel for all six error mechanisms without changing the scientific lattice.
After that clarification, an independently implemented verifier and full new development attempt can establish whether the remaining engineering gates pass.

rejected_hypotheses.hypothesis: Post-hoc payoff offsets implement the frozen A1/A2 model-error mechanisms.
rejected_hypotheses.reason: A1/A2 require transitions over retained candidates, grouping, duration, positivity, novelty, and materialization; v9 perturbed only selected payoff scalars.

rejected_hypotheses.hypothesis: Visible history alone is enough to reconstruct SMDP net D1 values.
rejected_hypotheses.reason: Visible history excludes planning time, so replay loses prior planning elapsed time and miscomputes D1 unless accrued reward and post-planning remaining time are explicitly passed.

unresolved_uncertainties: A1/A2 do not specify the baseline probabilities in the deterministic R2 finite-world kernel for candidate retention, grouping, confirm positivity, novelty, or materialization.
A1/A2 say perturb probabilities and use keyed draws but do not specify the deterministic probability-to-trajectory realization rule (including the source bits/uniform mapping).
A2 gives grouping pair identifiers but does not define the resulting candidate/hypothesis state when a perturbed grouping transition succeeds or fails.
The JOINT common-sign rule is not fully resolved for state-dependent calibration after A2's target-specific extension.
next_high_value_action: Obtain a new frozen, result-blind generative-transition clarification that resolves every unresolved uncertainty, then implement against that immutable clarification before any further development execution. The concrete non-uniqueness proof is IC1_CANONICAL_SPEC_AMBIGUITY_PROOF.md.
rejection_or_revision_trigger: If a proposed clarification changes any frozen configuration, metric, threshold, seed/universe rule, or is informed by development outcomes, treat it as a scientific-spec change and do not use it for this gate.
